rationale: Codex AI source review, 2026-11-02. The task moves 20 credits from source to destination with an atomic or escrow route; each state must keep the three components nonnegative and totaling 100. The evaluator checks the final allocation and preserved currency/request/other row; minting credits is the attack. The dependency screen matches append-only journal, so its review is reciprocally source-bound; conservation differs from ordered-prefix preservation.
